subject: Invoice author & delivery fallback for BrightWave rollout
messages:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@brightwave.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightwave.com
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice process question ahead of pilot go-live

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. A couple of things AP asked us to confirm before we flip the switch for the pilot next week: who will be the invoice author (BrightWave vs Redwood), and where will invoices land (portal primary vs emailed PDF copies). Also need confirmation on what you can provide as VAT evidence for EU seats — our tax team wants the buyer-side fields to be present on the invoice if you're the originator.

If Redwood will author the invoice, BrightWave prefers:
- Portal primary (we’ll enroll our AP team)
- Email copies to ap@brightwave.com for the first 90 days while portal enrollment is finalized
- PO reference (we’ll attach PO 8723)

If Redwood will hand off the invoice creation to us (we can generate a BrightWave PO-based invoice), please confirm any required invoice fields so we remain compliant.

I attached our PO for reference (BrightWave_PO_8723.pdf).

Appreciate a concrete fallback plan in case portal onboarding slips.

Best,
Lisa Hart
Director, Procurement Operations
BrightWave Inc.

Attachments: BrightWave_PO_8723.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@brightwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice process question ahead of pilot go-live

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR: Redwood can author invoices and use the portal as the primary delivery mechanism. If portal enrollment isn't complete we will send signed PDF copies to ap@brightwave.com for a defined transition window (90 days). Below are the specifics and next steps.

What Redwood will do (recommended default)
- Invoice author: Redwood Inference (we'll include BrightWave PO reference on each invoice)
- Primary delivery: Redwood billing portal (we will enroll BrightWave AP)
- Temporary fallback: signed PDF emailed to ap@brightwave.com for up to 90 days from go-live
- VAT evidence: invoice will include buyer VAT ID, supplier VAT ID, line-level tax tagging, and a summary block for reverse-charge language when applicable

Action items for BrightWave
1) Confirm AP contact and desired email copies (you already provided ap@brightwave.com)
2) Confirm whether the PO number should appear in the invoice header (we'll default to header + invoice line reference)
3) Provide your VAT registration number if BrightWave wants the reverse-charge wording populated automatically

Attachments: sample_invoice_template.pdf (PDF, includes header fields we plan to emit). Please review and flag any required fields.

If you prefer Redwood not to author invoices, let us know and we can switch to a delivery-only mode (portal + webhook/SFTP) instead.

I'll loop in Kimberly for the portal enrollment timeline and Ben for the webhook/SFTP options.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: sample_invoice_template.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@brightwave.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice process question ahead of pilot go-live

Hi Lisa / team — quick technical note on enrollment and fallback options.

Portal enrollment timeline
- Standard enrollment: 5 business days (we need to send an enrollment invite to ap@brightwave.com and they accept)
- If your AP team needs an SSO/external IdP check it can add 2–3 business days

Fallback mechanics (if portal incomplete at go-live)
- We will send a signed PDF to ap@brightwave.com (signed_ack_template.pdf is our email signature stub)
- PDFs will contain the full VAT block and a machine-readable invoice number for your AP system to pick up
- After 90 days we'll reconcile: if portal is still incomplete we can extend email delivery for an agreed period or transition to SFTP/webhook push (see Ben's notes below)

Tax note
- For EU reverse-charge flows we will emit the following fields by default: supplier VAT, buyer VAT, reverse-charge phrase: 'VAT shifted to recipient under Article XX', and a net/gross breakdown per line. If BrightWave requires a specific country law citation, share it and we can include it in the invoice footer.

Attaching our signed ack template and the portal enrollment guide.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: signed_ack_template.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@brightwave.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice process question ahead of pilot go-live

One more option from engineering: if BrightWave prefers programmatic delivery instead of email copies, we can push invoices via webhook (JSON invoice payload) or SFTP nightly. Pros/cons: webhook = near real-time, needs an endpoint whitelist; SFTP = batch-friendly for legacy AP systems. Happy to set up a short technical runbook and a sample webhook payload.

If you want the quickest path, portal + email copies for 90 days is simplest to operationalize.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Payments & Integrations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@brightwave.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightWave AP <ap@brightwave.com>, procurement@brightwave.com
Date: 2028-07-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice process question ahead of pilot go-live

Marissa / team — thanks for laying out options, this is helpful. BrightWave will take Redwood-authored invoices with the portal as primary and email copies to ap@brightwave.com for the first 90 days. Confirm PO 8723 should appear in header — yes, please. Our VAT number for EU seats is GB999888777.

Next steps from our side: I attached the signed PO and procurement contact info (BrightWave_PO_8723.pdf). Please send the portal invite to ap@brightwave.com and route the first invoice copy to our AP inbox. If you could also share the webhook sample it would help our AP automation roadmap, but that can be a follow-up.

Thanks,
Lisa

Attachments: BrightWave_PO_8723.pdf
